messages:
sanjay: RFC follow-up: propose `soft_hint` for prefix pinning instead of a new pin_type. goal: allow short-lived residency without full strong pin semantics.
elaine: +1 to a hint concept. How is it enforced? does it use credits or TTL?
kevin: Implementation idea: admission gives a tenant a pool of soft_credits. Each soft_hint consumes one credit while resident. Credits recharge slowly. If out of credits, soft_hint requests fail fast.
andre: That matches my concerns about fairness. Credits prevent a noisy tenant from soaking memory. We should tie credit caps to tenant plan + recent usage.
sanjay: Correct. API sketch (accepts either old or new fields):

```
POST /v1/prefix/pin
{
  "prefix": "team/foo/bar",
  "pin": true,          // legacy
  "soft_hint": true,    // new optional hint
  "hint_ttl": 20        // best-effort seconds
}
```

kevin: On eviction semantics: soft_hint means the prefix is demoted to a lower eviction queue. Eviction cycles prefer evicting soft-hinted entries first, but we allow N soft-evictions per prefix before it becomes a hard eviction.
elaine: Need clear read-after-write safety. If demote occurs, inflight writers might see stale data. Suggest attaching a small `residency_epoch` to prefix metadata. Reads/writes validate epoch and request rehydrate if mismatched.
andre: How big is the epoch? 1 byte? 2 bytes? We should keep metadata overhead minimal.
sanjay: 1 byte wrap-around is okay; compare-and-increment on demote. We persist epoch in prefix header in the slab. On handoff, include epoch in the handoff message.
kevin: Read path pseudocode:

``
if prefix.present and req.epoch == prefix.epoch:
  serve from cache
else if prefix.soft_hint and within_hint_ttl:
  best-effort serve but async rehydrate
else:
  fetch full
```

mira-bot: [notice] feature-flag `prefix_soft_hint_v1` enabled on canary ring (5% nodes).
elaine: Metric wishlist: soft_hint_grants, soft_hint_denies (credits exhausted), soft_hint_evictions, soft_to_hard_promotions, rawe_retries (read-after-write rehydrations).
andre: We should also export tenant_soft_credit_usage and reactive backoff counters. If tenant exceeds threshold, admission rejects new soft_hints and returns 429 with reason.
sanjay: Edge cases we discussed:
- crash while decrementing credits -> credits are adjusted using idempotent tokens and reconciliation job on start
- cross-shard handoff -> carry epoch + hint_ttl remaining
- prefetch interaction -> prefetches shouldn't acquire soft credits; they may honor existing soft_hint but not request new hints

kevin: Ops/console: add panel showing soft_hint hit rate, rejected soft_hint rate, and per-tenant credit utilization. Alert if too many soft_to_hard_promotions in 5m.
elaine: Rolling plan: enable on canary 5% with hint_ttl=10 and per-tenant starting credits=2, monitor 24h. If stable, 25% next.
andre: Also include automatic throttling: if tenant soft_to_hard_promotions > threshold, halve their credit regen rate for 30m.
sanjay: SDK note: expose a PinOptions struct with SoftHint bool and HintTtlSeconds int. Backwards compat if omitted.
kevin: One more: RBAC/enterprise: allow disabling soft_hint via org policy. Will add a policy check in admission.
mira-bot: [info] canary runbook created: /playbooks/prefix_soft_hint_canary. Targets: rawe_retries < 0.5%, soft_hint_denies < 0.1% of pin attempts.
elaine: Ok I can add metrics + console tile. andre: I'll own runtime admission + epoch + handoff. kevin: I'll update SDK + API surface. sanjay: I'll update RFC text and docs.
kevin: No blockers from me.
andre: +1
elaine: LGTM
mira-bot: [note] thread will auto-archive after 7 days of inactivity.
